cloudOffer.broughtToast: Now using {device}'s save for "{game}". This device's previous save was kept as a snapshot.

cloudOffer.reason.local-changed: This device's save changed since its last snapshot. Bringing the remote version would replace that progress, while keeping a safety snapshot.
cloudOffer.reason.local-content-time-unk: This device cannot verify the current save's content time, so the update requires confirmation.
